description: This file contains the implementation of an extended date/time library for PHP, supporting dates outside the native 1901-2038 range. It provides functions to convert between timestamps and formatted date strings, replace native PHP date functions, and handle historical calendar corrections (e.g., Gregorian calendar adjustments). It also includes utility functions for leap year calculations, date validation, and timezone difference calculations.

methods.name: adodb_date
methods.description: Main function to produce formatted date strings from timestamps, supporting extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_mktime
methods.description: Converts given local date/time components into a Unix timestamp, supporting dates outside the 1901-2038 range.

methods.name: adodb_gmdate
methods.description: Returns a GMT/UTC formatted date string from a timestamp, supporting extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_strftime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a locale-aware formatted date string, with extended date support.

methods.name: adodb_date2
methods.description: Converts ISO date strings or timestamps into formatted date strings supporting extended date ranges.

methods.name: adodb_getdate
methods.description: Returns an associative array of date components, supporting dates outside PHP's native range.
